title: 第2323章 小小沉寂一下 各队争取再次提升第2322章 爷爷放水 魔帝练手
content_zh:
魔帝铩羽而逃
消息不胫而走
隐世家族圈子很顶，也被这个消息震惊。
原因只有一个，让魔帝甘拜下风的武者是一位人族少年，而且至始至终都未出动本尊。
“四道分身对战魔帝本尊和三道分身，居然不战而屈人之兵。”
当时围观武者不在少数，更有来的早的一批，几乎看全了整个过程。
去得早的大都是武道境界较高的武者，洞察力强，还跑得快。
“当日各大势力的武者众多，要说去的早一批少年，还是在青苍山脉，神鹰帝国边境等地剿灭魔人的团队，清一色的青葱面孔，尤为引人注目。”
隐世家族情报网收集信息的探子很快如实上报。
之前就有很多大宗大派的高层对天团少年特别重视。
追寻着天团少年的脚步，每每到时都发现人已远走，总慢上那么一点点，无法释然。
观看郑风分身和魔帝的战斗，让追逐天团少年的大佬转移了注意力。
“这看似老者的武者是易了容，后来四道分身统一，才发现是一位青葱少年。
战力之强叹为观止！”
一群大佬散布四周，看得真切，他们心中有一个很大的疑惑。
“之前的万余名少年团队展现出来的强大战力已经令很多大宗大派叹而观止。”
“真要和人族隐世家族的天才少年比较也不遑多让。”
“岂止是不遑多让，隐世家族也是有三六九等，高低之分，
万余名天赋不错的少年，配合默契，武道种类繁多，丹符阵器四道自成团队，这样的组合，很多隐世家族也拿不出来。”
“或许只有隐世家族之首的郑家或许有可能！”

人类武者高层各抒己见，当然他们也没有想到天团少年是郑家小少主郑风的势力，主要是郑鹏替代郑风郑家小少主的身份已久，郑家又是数代单传，所以没有人向郑家小少主的身份去想。
提及郑家仅仅是因为郑家为隐世家族之首。
郑王临世风云现
并非指隐世家族就只有七大家族，而是说这七家在隐世家族的影响力靠前。
“王家小少主王慕远也不敢说手下或是家族拥有像天团少年这样猛地一塌糊涂的天骄团队。”
“尤其是他们的领队个个强悍！”
“有人心细如发，把景儿、吴曦枬、康昊、凌无虚、青鱼、郑杰、武神子、沐浩天等人的战斗场景，整理成独立玉简。”
“明眼人都看得出来，这些人是团队里的队长。”
“团队里少年超过九成，不足一成的美女，又以平日里不大出手，战斗时乘坐金凤的美女马首是瞻。”
“该女姿容绝世，身侧常有一英俊帅哥相陪。”
其实讲述之人不清楚景儿身侧常有吴曦枬代师相护，不熟悉天团少年的武者很难准确描述天团少年各成员的面容，个个都帅，帅哥扎堆。
content_en:
The Demon Emperor fled
The news spread like wildfire
The Hidden World family was very popular, and they were also shocked by the news.
There is only one reason. The warrior who defeated the Demon Emperor was a young human race, and he never used his true self from the beginning to the end.
"Four clones fought against the Demon Emperor's original self and three clones, and actually managed to defeat them without fighting."
There were not a few warriors watching at that time, and there were even a group of people who came early and saw almost the whole process.
Most of those who went early were warriors with a high level of martial arts, strong insights, and fast runners.
"There were many warriors from all the major forces that day. The early group of young people who left were the teams that were slaying demons in the Qingcang Mountains, the border of the Divine Eagle Empire and other places. Their uniformly green faces were particularly eye-catching."
The spies collecting information from the Hidden Family Intelligence Network quickly reported the truth truthfully.
In the past, many high-level officials of large sects paid special attention to the young people from Tiantuan.
Following the footsteps of the Tiantuan boy, I always find that he has gone far away, always a little slower, and I can't let go.
Watching the battle between Zheng Feng's clone and the Demon Emperor diverted the attention of the boss who was chasing the boy from Tiantuan.
"This warrior who looked like an old man had changed his appearance. Later, when the four clones were unified, it was discovered that he was a young man.
The fighting power is astonishing! "
A group of big guys were scattered around and it was clear that they had a big doubt in their hearts.
"The powerful combat power displayed by the previous team of more than 10,000 young people has astonished many large sects."
"If you really want to compare with the genius boy from the hidden family of the human race, he won't be far behind."
"Not only are there no concessions, the Hidden World family also has three, six or nine levels, divided into high and low.
More than 10,000 young people with good talents cooperate with each other tacitly, have a wide variety of martial arts, and form a team with four alchemy arrays. Many hidden families cannot come up with such a combination. "
"Maybe only the Zheng family, the head of the hidden family, might be able to do it!"
The top human warriors expressed their opinions. Of course, they did not expect that the Tiantuan boy was the influence of Zheng Feng, the young master of the Zheng family. The main reason was that Zheng Peng had replaced Zheng Feng as the young master of the Zheng family for a long time, and the Zheng family was a single generation for several generations, so no one thought about the identity of the young master of the Zheng family.
The Zheng family is mentioned only because the Zheng family is the head of the hidden family.
King Zheng's arrival in the world
It does not mean that there are only seven major families in the Hidden World, but it means that these seven families have the highest influence among the Hidden World families.
"Wang Muyuan, the young master of the Wang family, dare not say that his subordinates or his family have a team of geniuses like the Tiantuan boy who suddenly fell into chaos."
"Especially because their team leaders are all very strong!"
"Someone is as meticulous as a hair and compiled the battle scenes of Jing'er, Wu Xizhen, Kang Hao, Ling Wuxu, Qingyu, Zheng Jie, Wu Shenzi, Mu Haotian and others into independent jade slips."
"Anyone with a discerning eye can see that these people are the captains of the team."
"More than 90% of the team are young and less than 10% are beauties. Also, they usually don't take any action and ride on a golden phoenix during battle."
"This woman has extraordinary beauty, and she is always accompanied by a handsome man."
In fact, the person who told the story did not know that Jing'er was always protected by Wu Xizhen, a substitute teacher. It would be difficult for a warrior who was not familiar with Tiantuan Youth to accurately describe the faces of the Tiantuan Youth members. They were all handsome, and there were many handsome guys.
